cards.title: Telegram Knowledge Agent
cards.description: Telegram Mini App for saving and retrieving materials via bot intake. Features a personal library with collection stacks, hybrid PostgreSQL FTS & pgvector search, voice queries, and optional grounded AI answers — all inside Telegram.

slides.title: Personal Knowledge Library
slides.description: Every message, link, or file sent to the bot appears instantly in the library. Full-text search with filters, language toggle (RU / EN), and type icons keep hundreds of items navigable.

slides.title: Collection Stacks
slides.description: Group saved items into named stacks for focused review sessions. Each card shows the source, media preview, tags, and provenance link — swipe through the whole collection without leaving Telegram.

slides.title: Voice Search
slides.description: Tap the mic, speak a query — Whisper transcribes it on the server and runs a hybrid FTS & pgvector search. The recording is a query only; it is never stored as a library item.

slides.title: Per-User AI Connections
slides.description: Users bring their own OpenRouter key via PKCE OAuth — no shared model budget. Keys are encrypted at rest. Local FTS search keeps working with zero AI budget; grounded answers are opt-in.

cards.title: AutoService

slides.title: Cloud Ecosystem & Security

slides.title: Admin Dashboard & Schedule Control

slides.title: Smart Booking & Real-Time Slots
